name: Grid coordinates and lattice reasoning
definition: Points on a grid can be named by how far across and how far up they sit. Once positions have numbers, distance, direction and repetition become arithmetic. Most grid problems are really about the difference between counting lines and counting spaces.
recognizeWhen: the point is three squares right and two up
give the coordinates of the corner
the grid is labelled along the edges
move along the lines of the grid
misconceptions: I counted the gridlines when I should have counted the squares between them.
I wrote the up number first and the across number second.
I started counting at one instead of at the origin.
